findings.evidence: SafetyOwner.census stores a provisional pidfd before post-open identity/starttime/UID/fdinfo validation. A caught mismatch leaves it signalable under the old identity.
findings.impact: Source-level race could signal an unrelated reused-PID process during cleanup.
findings.requiredFix: Validate unattached local handle completely before transfer; close on every failure; failed custody must never be signalable.
requiredRegressions: Post-open live foreign PID reuse closes fd and sends zero signals.
Post-open identity/UID mismatch, identity exception and fdinfo mismatch/read failure close provisional fd.
Failed custody cannot use numeric fallback; valid custody keeps normal cleanup.
findings.qualification: Source inspection only; no actual foreign signal, runtime race or exploit observed.

findings.requiredRegression: Persistent census failure after validated ownership must still stop/reap known children and retain FAIL.
findings.qualification: Source analysis only; no observed runtime leak.
